meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: Vacation rental and short-term rental property management software (channel manager, PMS, direct booking)

analysis.summary: Hostaway publishes the most, with 18 new pages and 52 updates, mostly guides for people still learning. Rivals focus elsewhere: Hospitable on money and tax, OwnerRez on existing users, Lodgify on landing pages, Uplisting on integrations.

points.text: Hostaway is running a big refresh push: 52 older pages updated, many on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com rule changes.
Hospitable is building a money and compliance story: payments, trust accounting and tax pages, with 15 new pages.
OwnerRez writes mainly for current customers: 14 of its news pages are about integrations, updates and podcasts, with few pages for new buyers.

Hostaway.play: Big library of guides, rule-change updates and comparisons, plus new pages for large operators and renewal audits.

Hospitable.play: Payments, damage insurance, tax and trust accounting pages, plus beginner host guides and podcasts.
Hospitable.aimed: Hosts and managers wanting finance tools

OwnerRez.play: Integration announcements, weekly news roundups, podcasts and user profiles. Almost nothing for new buyers.

Lodgify.play: Refreshed product pages by website builder, niche and channel, with Greek versions and comparison pages.

Uplisting.play: One landing page per integration partner, plus new compliance, task and deposit product pages.

shared.title: Airbnb rule-change coverage
shared.text: Hostaway, OwnerRez and Uplisting all wrote about Airbnb's new rules and house rules. Speed and clear host steps matter in this topic.

shared.title: Insurance and damage protection
shared.text: Hostaway launched Insurance powered by Safely. Hospitable launched Guest Damage Insurance. Uplisting added a deposit and dispute page. Protection is becoming part of the software pitch.

shared.title: Partner and integration pages
shared.text: OwnerRez has integration news pages. Uplisting has partner landing pages. Hospitable has a partner page. All three use partners to build credibility.

gaps.title: Trust accounting and tax for Hostaway
gaps.text: Hospitable has 5 or more pages on trust accounting, tax and payments, including Australia. Hostaway shows only finance-management guides here, so this is open to own.

gaps.title: Local-market PMS pages
gaps.text: Hostaway has pages on Dubai and Spain case studies and country rules. Few rivals do this. Lodgify uses Greek but not market case studies. Build more by region.

gaps.title: Switching and renewal content
gaps.text: Only Hostaway has audit-before-renewing pages. No rival has a clear guide on how to migrate between systems. Own this for people leaving a rival.

versus.Hospitable: Narrower and more focused on finance and tax. Hostaway publishes more guides and comparisons but has less on trust accounting and payments.
versus.OwnerRez: Writes for existing customers with news and podcasts. Hostaway writes more for people still learning and comparing, with 47 how-to pages.
versus.Lodgify: Leans on product landing pages and 61 updates, many in Greek. Hostaway has more guides, research and case studies.
versus.Uplisting: Smaller and mostly integration landing pages. Hostaway covers more of the buyer journey, though Uplisting has newer compliance and task pages.
